resources.string: Create a project from TXT or open a .lnt file. TXT originals can be up to 8 MiB.
No projects yet. Choose a TXT or .lnt file to begin.
Existing library data is preserved. Migration to projects is not available yet.
%1$d project folders need recovery. Existing projects are preserved.
The private project could not be opened. Refresh or import a saved copy.
Agent chat is not available in this build. You can edit text and save your project.
Automatic translation is not connected yet. Manual editing and export are available.
Only processed entries use their saved translation, including empty text. Other entries use the original. Identical original and translated lines are shown once in bilingual output.
This asset has no text entries. The original file is preserved.
Operation cancelled. Refresh to check any changes already saved.
The saved entry has changed. Your draft is preserved. Reload the saved value before trying again.
Your unsaved changes will be lost.
The file or text exceeds the supported limit.
The text cannot be decoded. Check the selected encoding.
This project version is not supported.
This file is not a supported LNT TXT project, or its contents are damaged.
The operation could not finish. Existing project data is preserved.
Another operation is still running. Try again after it finishes.
Access to the selected file was denied. Select the file again.
Temporary exports cleared. Saved projects are unchanged.

This is a local workflow test, not a real translation. It writes [SIMULATION] plus the original text into nonblank, unprocessed entries on this page only. Saved and excluded entries stay unchanged. Duplicate your project first if needed. No network or paid requests are made.
Local simulation finished. Saved results are kept.
Local workflow buttons use Koog without network access. Configure a remote model for conversation. The manual proposal form tests approval and does not generate model text.
One entry will be replaced with the proposed translation and marked processed. Approval applies once to this fixed difference.
The result is unresolved. Refresh to check the project receipt; it will not execute automatically.

Configure a compatible Chat Completions endpoint. HTTP and HTTPS are supported. API key is optional; a non-empty key is encrypted on this device. Saving does not send a request. Fetch models only queries the model list.
Configure a model to send messages. Local workflow buttons work without a model.
Sending shares the conversation and requested source text with the selected endpoint and may incur charges. Edits require approval.
Model authentication failed. Check the configuration. No automatic retry.
The model request failed or timed out. No automatic retry; the request may have reached the provider.
The provider is busy or rate limited. No automatic retry.
Conversation budget exceeded. Start a new chat.
The model response was incomplete or invalid. Saved project results are kept.
The request result needs reconciliation. It will not be sent again automatically.
Conversation history is incomplete or invalid. Start a new chat; existing records are kept.
Some Agent data could not be verified. Refresh or reopen the project. Approval and sending are disabled until verification succeeds.
Check the HTTP/HTTPS API base, model ID and API key. URLs cannot contain credentials, query parameters or fragments. A non-empty key must use printable ASCII without spaces.
The run was interrupted. Saved changes remain. Check the project before starting a new run; nothing is replayed automatically.
A request or commit could not be confirmed. Check saved changes and provider usage before sending a new request, which may incur another charge. Nothing is retried automatically.
Run recovery could not be loaded. Refresh before starting another task.
Use an API base such as http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 or a LAN address. A pasted /chat/completions or /models suffix is removed. localhost refers to this Android device.
HTTP is unencrypted. Use it for a trusted local or LAN service.
Use saved API key (same endpoint only)
No models returned. You can still enter a model ID manually.
Model list authentication failed. Check the key or enter a model ID manually.
Could not fetch models. Check the endpoint, or enter a model ID manually.
Ask about the source, read specific items, or propose a translation. Project changes require your approval. Local tools work without a model.
Review the pending change before continuing the conversation.
Tool activity — open the message for details.
Only the latest output is shown here. The full reply is recorded after completion.
This partial preview stays only on this page and has not been committed as a complete reply.
Could not start background processing. Saved results are kept. Try again while the app is visible.
Local simulation can continue while you leave the app. System limits or process termination can interrupt it; saved results are kept. Notifications are optional.
The project view could not be refreshed. The task is still attached; you can stop it here. Saved results are kept.
Case-sensitive literal text; no wildcards or regular expressions.
Edits keep the current page members. Apply again to refresh membership.
Clear filters to run the page simulation.
Change %1$d affected entries: %2$s. Only this fixed selection is included.
This clears the selected translations and marks them unprocessed.
A failed attempt retains this exact batch. Confirm again to reconcile or retry it.
The project changed. Close this preview, refresh and prepare a new selection.
The selection already has these values.
The batch was applied, but the page could not refresh. Refresh to read the saved results.

Process every unprocessed, nonblank item in this project with the local simulation. Existing processed and excluded items stay as they are. Each completed batch is saved; stopping keeps saved results. No model request is sent and no automatic restart occurs. The view returns to the first page.
Statistics for this run only. Missing usage is unknown, not zero. These totals are not a billing statement.
